description.0: A long spear that once stood guard over all. Today, it has found a new purpose with children and their games of make-believe.

0.0: Triggering an Elemental Reaction regenerates <cryo>4</cryo> Elemental Energy for the equipping character. This effect can trigger once every 9s. On the other hand, triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their ATK by <cryo>20%</cryo> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
